claims.text: ⍉specific therapy: supportive, mainly nutrition incl vitamins A, D, E and K supplements.
claims.quote: If there is no specific therapy, treatment is supportive and consists primarily of nutritional therapy, including supplements of vitamins A, D, E, and K (1).

claims.text: Formula-fed infants: formula ↑ in medium-chain TG (better absorbed w bile salt deficiency).
claims.quote: For formula-fed infants, a formula that is high in medium-chain triglycerides should be used because it is absorbed better in the presence of bile salt deficiency.

claims.text: Some bile flow: ursodeoxycholic acid QD or BID may relieve itching, improve bile flow and possibly liver dz.
claims.quote: In infants with some bile flow, ursodeoxycholic acid once or twice a day may relieve itching, improve bile flow, and potentially improve liver disease.
